results.text: "Best" depends on the measure, and the two channels rank differently. mobile_app has the higher completion rate (**72.84%** against **68.83%**), but web opens more of its applications (**75.47%** against **59.32%**). Tell me which measure you mean and I will rank on it.

sql.command: SELECT channel, SUM(applications_submitted) / SUM(sessions_started) AS completion_rate, SUM(applications_approved) / SUM(applications_submitted) AS submit_to_open_rate FROM aa_digital_funnel GROUP BY channel
